entities.summary: Modinagar is a town and a municipal board in Ghaziabad district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is 24 km from Ghaziabad city, 48 km from New Delhi. It is a part of National Capital Region. Modinagar is a town in South Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
